item.reason: Main validators file for all plugin contracts
Validators for guard, evaluator, provider types

story-context.constraints: - MUST use satisfies Type<T> for ALL validators (CLAUDE.md rule) - NEVER use 'any' type - NEVER use Record<string, unknown> as shortcut - Start with zero-dependency types first, build up - Use proper ArkType methods (.array(), .or(), type.valueOf()) - Semver validation using regex or semver library - Clear error messages for developer experience - All validators must be exported for external use - Build validators from simple to complex types

tests.standards: Jest unit tests, test validation success and failure cases, verify error messages
tests.ideas: - Test valid manifest passes validation - Test missing required fields fail with clear errors - Test invalid semver format fails - Test invalid plugin type fails - Verify error messages are actionable - Test nested type validation - Test satisfies Type compilation - Test array and optional field validation
